character_response_actor.evidence: Both subjects are visibly adult; the man is athletic, blond, suntanned, and wears the coral resort shirt.

character_response_baseline.evidence: His serious attention is readable, but the residual cocky half-smile is not clearly visible.

character_response_trigger.evidence: The paperback is clearly present but reads as upright and held, not visibly tilting during the beat.

character_response_target.evidence: His head, torso, and braced arm all orient toward the same adult woman.

character_response_primary_action.evidence: His open palm is planted on the white wall above and beside her head while he leans toward her.

character_response_affect_leak.evidence: The attentive gaze survives, but the intended simultaneous cocky-to-serious facial transition does not.

character_response_visible_response.evidence: Her widened eyes, parted lips, and sideways gaze toward him make the startled response readable.

character_response_immediate_consequence.evidence: The book remains firmly upright against her chest, so a small downward drop is not legible.

character_response_continuity.evidence: The same man's open hand remains visibly braced beside the same woman in the single frame.
